scope_plain: Parts of Nashville and Davidson County: the southeastern part of the county, in congressional District 4 as redrawn in May 2026. The district also covers most of Rutherford County and counties to the southeast.
office_explainer: One of 435 House members. Writes federal laws and votes on the budget and taxes. Two-year term.
why_it_matters: New lines this year: the May 2026 redraw moved southeastern Davidson County into District 4.
